description: ADO-PARAM construction: for twenty CreateParameter argument lists on a Command with one '?' marker (no arguments; name only; Integer with and without a value; VarWChar without Size, with Size 2 and a six-character value, with Size 0 and with Size -1; LongVarWChar 100; Decimal; Currency; Date; Boolean; VarBinary 3 bytes; GUID; an undefined Type 9999; an undefined Direction 99; Output and ReturnValue directions with no value; Integer with Size 8), read Name, Type, Direction, Size, Precision, NumericScale, Attributes and Value of the new Parameter, Append it to a fresh Command's collection, read Count and the Errors. Asks the defaults CreateParameter assigns and which arguments are refused at CreateParameter or at Append.
